🔥Don't forget your OS, we have Windows 11 OEM, Download and USB versions available

Unleash the performance of the AMD 9800X3D CPU with a premium X870E motherboard, RGB liquid CPU cooler, high speed DDR5 and SSD.

Maximize the power of GeForce 5000 series cards with Gen5 NVMe SSD.

Overview

Specs

Reviews (171)

Keep your system going with FSP's SAGA+ 450W Max power supply. This is a great choice for upgrading an older system if you want to keep your old case. Filled with new technology, it's designed to keep you powered up well into the future. Greater than 70% efficiency and 1W standby mode will help save you money on your electric bills.

The back of the housing is a hexagonal mesh to maximize airflow from the 120mm fan. The large openwork will also minimize air noise caused by the fan. Advanced thermal monitoring circuitry keeps the PSU regulated for efficient performance.

It comes with the standard connectors, power, CPU, floppy and Molex. It also has 2 SATA connections so you can use today's high speed drives. Dual +12V power rails ensure a balanced power output. A 6 pin PCIe connector feeds extra power to your video card.

- Efficient CoolingA 120mm riffle bearing fan plus hexagon cutouts increases overall airflow in the power supply enclosure and helps remove heat from the chassis simultaneously.
- 450W Maximum PowerA maximum power of 450W delivers safe, reliable output for mainstream computer systems.
- ATX12V v2.2 CompatibleCompatible with the ATX12V v2.2 standard, the FSP Group SAGA+ 450R power supply provides maximum power stability to drive the latest Intel and AMD processors as well as other system components.
